item.title: Messages From Beyond! Can Spirits Really Guide Us? (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Dr. Lana Duncan-Hartgraves is a psychic medium, spiritual guide, author, and educator with more than 30 years of experience helping people explore their spiritual journeys and connect with the unseen world. Holding a PhD in Metaphysical Science with an emphasis in Education, she is currently pursuing a second doctorate in Metaphysical Counseling. As an evidential medium, Reiki Master, hypnotist, and holistic practitioner, Lana combines intuitive insight with spiritual guidance to help individuals discover healing, clarity, and personal growth. Her extensive background as an art educator has also shaped her passion for teaching others to develop their intuition, creativity, and spiritual awareness.

Lana is also the author of Memoirs of an Accidental Psychic, a fascinating personal account of her experiences with psychic abilities, spirit communication, and her journey into the metaphysical world. Her other published works include The Royal Fellow Who Banished Yellow and Just Shades of Brown. Through readings, workshops, and spiritual education, Lana encourages people to embrace their intuitive gifts and explore the possibility of receiving guidance from beyond. She is also developing an equine therapy center, bringing together spiritual healing, human connection, and the therapeutic power of horses.

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern.  We broadcast LIVE every night.
